notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
Hey Witches!

A lot has happened since the last update in February.
We released a new demo update with a new map, additional cards, and a new game mode. 
Here’s what’s new:


Frozen Lake
A new map has been added. Frozen Lake leans toward the larger end of what we’re aiming for in terms of map size and offers a more distinct visual style.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/9d3dc9b0c8a66c3e615e7bcd23315b9f8d81c6c5.gif"]



Suit Of Pentacles
The Pentacle suit is now available and expands your deck with support-oriented options and long-term scaling effects.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/c8daf8ca67e22fff4430b07e54eaeb03501cd92d.png"]


The Chariot & Mage Rework
The Chariot has been added, a powerful movement card that brings a witch's most important tool into play: The Broom. 
We've also reworked the Magician card: Now each suit features its own Mage, summoning skeletons that follow Clovelin and cast passive attacks tied to their element. The first two, Wands and Cups, are already in the demo, Swords and Pentacles are still in testing




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/a0fd699b5875f10b50794d41720c9322c06ed8b1.png"]


Survival Mode
The demo now includes a new mode focused on time based progression. This benefits a more aggressive playstyle.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/c9c2898685936cd64f681c90193fdde8c9341abe.png"]


QoL Improvements
Tooltips for cards during combat

Automatic wave-start zoom

Basic resolution and audio settings

Visual and performance updates


Stay tuned as we'll soon add a variety of new enemies!


See you in Hell!



Dayshift
